accounting_contract.occupied_input_tokens_definition: The exact sum of host/system instruction, project instruction, task instruction, and existing conversation tokens already occupying the deployed context. It excludes retrieved KB tokens and candidate evidence tokens.
accounting_contract.cached_input_tokens_definition: An informational subset of occupied_input_tokens. Cached tokens still occupy context and are never subtracted from occupancy.
accounting_contract.retrieved_kb_tokens_definition: Retrieved KB tokens already occupying context and excluded from occupied_input_tokens so they are subtracted exactly once.
accounting_contract.tool_output_reserve_tokens_definition: Context reserved for expected tool outputs that may arrive before the public response.
accounting_contract.response_reserve_tokens_definition: Context reserved for the expected public response or other required output.
accounting_contract.safety_margin_tokens_definition: Additional non-overlapping context headroom reserved for tokenizer variance and orchestration overhead.
accounting_contract.candidate_evidence_tokens_definition: Post-ingestion evidence proposed for one evaluation or the complete screenshot batch before work begins. It is not part of occupied_input_tokens.
accounting_contract.available_evidence_formula: context_window_tokens - occupied_input_tokens - retrieved_kb_tokens - tool_output_reserve_tokens - response_reserve_tokens - safety_margin_tokens
accounting_contract.overlap_policy: The occupied-input components must sum exactly to occupied_input_tokens. Retrieved KB and candidate evidence must remain separate. Any declared overlap, mismatch, negative or non-finite value, or reservation total above the context window is rejected.

evidence_tokens.role: absolute post-ingestion evidence ceilings; runtime-effective thresholds may be lower

warning_action: Continue only if the admitted evidence can be processed without reducing evaluation quality and all response and tool reserves remain intact; otherwise sequence the work and report what remains.
hard_limit_action: Reject admission or stop before processing more evidence, preserve completed results, and report every measured component, the effective hard limit, and the unprocessed remainder. Never silently truncate evidence.
invalid_accounting_action: Reject admission until the host supplies a complete, finite, non-negative, non-overlapping accounting record for the deployed context window. Do not guess missing metadata.
host_webapp_responsibility: authentication, authorization, quotas, and rate limits
notes: These budgets apply only after the host has accepted and exposed evidence to the agent.
This file does not validate uploads, attachments, images, PDFs, archives, or transport-level payloads.
The 24000/32000 token values are absolute evidence ceilings, not claims that either amount fits the deployed runtime.
Token counts supplied by the host are authoritative. A byte-derived estimate is a scheduling signal and cannot authorize evidence admission.
The same context-aware calculation applies to a complete screenshot batch before the batch begins.
